summary: NexPoint Capital, a non-traded Delaware BDC, filed a routine Form 8-K reporting Item 2.02 results and Item 8.01 other events. The board declared a $0.09 per share cash distribution payable October 13, 2026, to holders of record September 30, 2026. Separately, the adviser determined the September 30, 2026 net asset value per share and distribution reinvestment plan price at $4.44 per share under Rule 2a-5. No acquisition, tender, strategic review, or management change is present; the filing is an ordinary distribution and NAV notice with no transaction terms to arbitrage.
